description: Kanhe protocol v0.22 test vectors: range proofs (spec sections 5, 6, 11, and 11.3). `system`: system 1, the library, its commit, and the circuit's name and id. `provable`: key 8 of a registration (the CDDL `provable`), valid with its entries decoded and refused, each for one rule, with the record's field count. `values`: values read as the integer x in each encoding, at the ends of the ranges, with v = x + 2^63 in decimal and the commitment SHA-256("Kanhe range v1" || salt || BE64(v)) under the given salt. `bounds`: bounds refused in an encoding, each named for its rule. `words`: statements in words. `transcripts`: the deterministic encoding T of ["kanhe.range/1", ledger, record, field, C, lo', hi', context], with lo' and hi' in decimal. `openings`: range openings files (`.kanheopenings`), valid with the commitments of its openings and refused. `ledger`: a log whose registrations carry provable values (one superseding another with its own), and signed registrations refused after it, `malformed` when they do not parse. `bundles`: evidence bundles with range proofs (key 12), each with the options to verify it with (as testvectors/evidence-v1.json gives them, `range_context` among them), the verdict, for a failure the section and step that decide it, for a verified bundle facts its JSON report must show, matched as in evidence-v1.json, and `range_systems` on each case whose verdict or facts need system 1's arithmetic. Written by tools/testvectors/range_vectors.py from the specification with evidence_suite.py's forge and throwaway Ed25519 keys (seed = SHA-256("Kanhe test key: evidence <name>")), salts SHA-256("Kanhe test range salt: <ledger> <name>"), and proofs of system 1 made by the program that proves with the Longfellow ZK library (the reference implementation's kanhe-range) from the seed SHA-256("Kanhe test range seed: " || T), for tests only: a real prover draws fresh randomness for every proof (section 11.3).

names ascending by their UTF-8 bytes
64 entries, as many as the fields

refused.name: more entries than the record's fields
an entry that is not a list
a name that is a byte string
a number of a negative scale
money in a currency of four letters
too many digits after the point
too many digits after the point
too many digits after the point

words.text: balance is between HKD -250.00 and HKD 1,000,000.00

refused.name: a mechanism type with provable values
an empty list of provable values

bundles.name: range-proof-verified
bundles.description: An employment record whose registration marks a date, an amount, and a number provable, and a range proof that the date is at most 2008-11-20, without a context.

bundles.name: range-proof-context-required
bundles.description: A range proof that the monthly salary is at least HKD 30,000.00, carrying a relying party's challenge as its context, verified by a verifier that requires that context.

bundles.name: range-proofs-three
bundles.description: Three range proofs of one record: a date at most a bound, money at least a bound with a context, and a number of scale 1 between an integer and a decimal text.

bundles.name: range-provable-no-proofs
bundles.description: A record with provable values and no range proofs: the report lists the provable values only.

bundles.name: range-proof-tampered
bundles.description: A range proof with one bit of its proof flipped: it does not verify under system 1.

bundles.name: range-context-missing
bundles.description: A range proof without a context, verified by a verifier that requires one: a required context is missing.

bundles.name: range-context-other
bundles.description: A range proof whose context is one challenge, verified by a verifier that requires another.

bundles.name: range-system-unknown
bundles.description: A valid proof of system 1, labelled system 2, which is not defined.

bundles.name: range-field-not-provable
bundles.description: A range proof of the field name, which the record has but its registration does not mark provable.

bundles.name: range-field-twice
bundles.description: Two copies of one valid range proof: a field is proven at most once in a bundle.

bundles.name: range-low-above-high
bundles.description: A range proof of the number score between 99.5 and 60: its low is above its high.

bundles.name: range-money-other-currency
bundles.description: The valid proof that the salary is at least HKD 30,000.00, its low written in USD: a bound is in the provable's currency.

bundles.name: range-money-other-scale
bundles.description: The valid proof that the salary is at least HKD 30,000.00, its low written as [30000, "HKD", 0], an equal amount of another scale: a bound has the provable's scale.

bundles.name: range-number-too-many-decimals
bundles.description: A range proof that the score, a number of scale 1, is at least "60.25", which has two digits after the point.

bundles.name: range-bound-out-of-range
bundles.description: A range proof that the score, a number of scale 1, is at most 922337203685477581, whose x is above 2^63 - 1.

bundles.name: range-date-before-year-one
bundles.description: A range proof of the date birth_date at least 0000-12-31, before 0001-01-01.

bundles.name: range-proof-without-bound
bundles.description: A range proof with neither a low nor a high.

bundles.name: range-proof-unknown-key
bundles.description: A range proof with a key 7, which the CDDL does not define.

bundles.name: range-proof-empty-context
bundles.description: A range proof with a context of 0 bytes.

bundles.name: range-proof-sm3-ledger
bundles.description: An SM3 ledger's record with a provable amount, whose commitment is SHA-256, and a range proof that it is at least CNY 10,000.00.

bundles.name: range-proof-negative-values
bundles.description: A number of scale 1 below zero proven between -20 and -10.0, and a date before 1970 proven at most 1950-01-01.

bundles.name: range-proof-revoked-record
bundles.description: A range proof of a revoked record's provable value: it verifies, and the record is reported revoked.

bundles.name: range-provable-on-mechanism-type
bundles.description: An access receipt, of a mechanism type, whose registration marks a value provable: the ledger refuses it.

bundles.name: range-proofs-in-instance-bundle
bundles.description: An instance's contract evidence whose bundle carries a range proof: only a record's bundle carries them.

bundles.name: range-proofs-in-source-proof
bundles.description: A record whose registration names a source on another ledger, and whose bundle carries that source's evidence with a valid range proof in it: a source proof carries none.
